title: Wrong or damaged item
text: If the delivered item differs from the item in the order record, verify the order belongs to the authenticated customer and compare the ordered and delivered item. For an eligible delivered mismatch, create a return request. Replacement timing is subject to warehouse confirmation. Do not promise a dispatch date unless a verified order system provides it.

title: Payment debited but order failed
text: When payment is marked debited_not_confirmed or the order is payment_failed, check the transaction and order status before promising a refund. The support system may flag the case for billing review. Never claim money has been refunded unless the payment system confirms it.

title: Account locked or login failure
text: For account access issues, verify the authenticated customer identity and check account status. Never disclose another customer's information or bypass authentication. If account status cannot be safely verified, escalate to account support.

title: Subscription inactive
text: For a subscription that appears inactive, check the subscription and payment status. If the billing status and account status disagree, collect the relevant identifiers and route the case to subscription engineering. Do not assert activation until the system confirms it.

title: Order cancellation rules
text: A demo order can be cancelled automatically only while its status is processing. Shipped or delivered orders cannot be cancelled through the cancellation tool; explain the limitation and offer the applicable return workflow instead.

title: Fraud, legal and data-breach reports
text: Treat suspected fraud, unauthorized transactions, legal threats and personal-data breach reports as sensitive. Do not attempt speculative account or payment changes. Create a high-priority case for Trust & Safety, Security Response or Legal Support and communicate the ticket reference and response target.

title: Delayed shipment and tracking
text: Check the order's current shipping status, courier and estimated delivery information before replying. If the tracking record has no current estimate or the shipment is materially delayed, escalate to delivery support rather than inventing an ETA.

title: Refund eligibility and timelines
text: Check the order and payment state before discussing refunds. Eligibility in this demo means the case can be reviewed, not that money has been transferred. Communicate only the timeline and outcome supported by the transaction record and policy.

title: Stop subscription auto-renewal
text: For auto-renewal requests, identify the customer's subscription and explain the cancellation or renewal-management process. Do not claim auto-renewal was disabled unless a connected subscription tool confirms the change.

title: Coupon and discount issues
text: For a coupon issue, ask for the code and relevant order/cart context. Check expiry, eligible products, minimum spend and customer eligibility where available. Do not invent coupon conditions when the knowledge base does not contain them.

title: Customer privacy and data access
text: Only retrieve customer and order data for the authenticated customer or an explicitly authorized support workflow. Refuse requests to expose other customers' private information. Log suspicious access attempts and escalate suspected data exposure.

title: Support ticket priority and SLA
text: Sensitive fraud or data-breach cases receive a five-minute initial-response target in this demo. High-priority issues use a fifteen-minute target and ordinary cases use sixty minutes. These are demonstration targets, not a contractual guarantee. Supervisors should monitor overdue tickets and record handoff status.
